nom: The INKEY List Hydrating Cream-To-Milk Cleanser with Hyaluronic Acid

avis.texte: I've been really impressed with this Hydrating Cream Milk Cleanser. It has a rich, creamy texture that gently removes makeup, sunscreen, and daily impurities without leaving my skin feeling tight or dry. Unlike many cleansers, it doesn't strip away my skin's natural moisture. The hyaluronic acid provides an extra boost of hydration, leaving my skin feeling soft, smooth, and refreshed after every wash. It's gentle enough for daily use and works especially well for dry or sensitive skin. If you're looking for a cleanser that effectively cleans while nourishing your skin, this one is definitely worth trying. The size and price make it an excellent value, so you can enjoy a quality skincare product without breaking the bank. As an esthetician who enjoys trying new skincare products, I'm always looking for formulas that are both effective and affordable—and this cleanser delivers on both. I would definitely recommend it!
I was happy with this purchase ! Perfect for travel ! Very creamy !

avis.titre: The first cream cleanser for ANY skin type
avis.texte: This cleanser is crazy impressive! I have a normal skin type that goes oiler in summer and dryer in winter and I'm very new to oil and cream cleansers. My teenage/20s skin was oily, so I've always used gels or foams in the past. I genuinely think even oily skin types can use this! It's the perfect morning cleanser or night cleanser to take off my sunscreen. I don't often wear makeup, so I can't attest to it's makeup removal but it removes water-resistant sunscreen perfectly. The cream emulsifies beautifully with water! AND rinses completely cleanly with 0 film or oiliness but leaves your skin so soft and unstripped. This cleanser is a game changer!

avis.titre: Gentle Hydration in a Tube: A Must-Have for Sensit
avis.texte: As someone with sensitive skin I'm always cautious about introducing new products but this cleanser has been nothing short of gentle and effective.The texture starts as a creamy consistency and transforms into a milky emulsion upon contact with water making it easy to massage into the skin. It effectively removes daily grime and light makeup without leaving my skin feeling stripped or tight. In fact my skin feels soft and hydrated after each use.One of the standout features is its formulation. The inclusion of ceramides and glycerin helps maintain the skins natural barrier and retain moisture which is a boon for those of us with dry or sensitive skin. Additionally the absence of fragrance and harsh chemicals means it's less likely to cause irritation.While it is excellent for daily cleansing I did notice that it struggles a bit with removing heavy or waterproof makeup. For those occasions I pair it with a dedicated makeup remover.Overall The Inkey List Hydrating Cream-to-Milk Cleanser is a gentle hydrating option that's perfect for daily use especially for those with sensitive skin. It's affordable effective and has earned a permanent spot on my bathroom shelf. Honest review submitted in exchange for product gifted by The INKEY List
